text.ja: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM Re100の蓋駆動キャビティ この問題の式、参照の条件、計算法、公開済みのコードをたどります。 保存済みの結果図 保存した最細Re100計算の流線と速さ。赤点は格子上の主渦、白抜き点はGhia表Vの主渦位置です。 方程式・問題の定義 無次元の単位正方形、ν=.01、蓋速度U=1、Re=100。上面の内部節点だけu=1、他壁と四隅の速度は0、全壁ψ=0。初期内部渦度は0。壁渦度はThom条件で各Heun段に再設定します。 非圧縮Navier–Stokes ∂tu+(u⋅∇)u=−ρ−1∇p+ν∇2u ∇⋅u=0 一定密度・粘性の代表形。周期2D MAC射影・Taylor–Green渦に加え、圧力を消去する非周期Re100キャビティを別配布で検証します。 等温格子BGK fq(x+cq,t+1)=fq(x,t)−fq−fqeqτ+Sq 格子単位Δx=Δt=1の衝突・並進更新。D2Q9等温・低Mach数のせん断波とPoiseuille流を扱います。 実行例で使う式 補助実行例実行例の定義・検証式 fiˉ(x,t+1)=fi⋆(x,t)−6wiρ0ci⋅uw,ρ0=1 Re=UL/ν=100,t⋆=100 4壁のBGK更新を3固定格子で実行し、nominal蓋速度で正規化したGhia中心線、主渦、定常性と壁運動量収支を検査します。 厳密解・参照解 21単体検査と群全体94判定を事前固定。原著の表I/II（印刷398–399頁）を直接確認して転記した17点ずつへ線形補間し、最細の各速度最大誤差≤.03、細分化で減少、定常残差≤1e−7を検査します。表Vの主渦位置・壁値・Poisson残差・離散発散も確認します。 有限格子の数値参照同じ問題の参照 Ghia Re100：原著の有限格子速度中心線 u_ref(.5,y_j),v_ref(x_j,.5): original TablesI/II Re100; primary vortex(x,y)=(.6172,.7344): TableV. 単位正方形、Re100、蓋速度1、他壁静止。Ghia原著の表I/IIのRe100列から速度u(0.5,y)とv(x,0.5)各17点を直接確認して転記し、印刷された4桁座標を保持します。表Vの格子上の主渦位置(.6172,.7344)を別に比較します。丸めを含む有限格子数値表で、厳密な連続解でも今回のソルバー出力でもありません。 Re=100・3固定格子の教育用検査です。蓋と側壁の角に速度の不連続があり、角の速度は静止側を優先します。Ghia値は丸めた数値参照で厳密解ではなく、4桁座標をそのまま使います。高Re・乱流・原著アルゴリズムの再現・キャビティ圧力を検証したとは主張しません。 有限格子の数値参照関連モデルの参照 LBMのRe100キャビティ：実2D場とGhia中心線 Ghia1982Re100 centerline text.en: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM Re100 lid-driven cavity Explore this problem’s equations, reference conditions, methods and published code. Saved result figure Saved finest Re100 streamlines and speed. Red dot: computed grid primary vortex; hollow dot: original Ghia TableV location. Equations and problem definitions Dimensionless unit square, viscosity.01, lid speed1, Re100. Top interior nodes haveu1; other walls and all four corners have zero velocity. Psi0 on every wall; initial interior vorticity0. Reapply Thom wall vorticity at every Heun stage. Incompressible Navier–Stokes ∂tu+(u⋅∇)u=−ρ−1∇p+ν∇2u ∇⋅u=0 Representative constant-density/viscosity flow. In addition to periodic2D MAC projection/Taylor–Green, a separate release verifies a pressure-eliminated nonperiodic Re100 cavity. Isothermal lattice BGK fq(x+cq,t+1)=fq(x,t)−fq−fqeqτ+Sq Collision/streaming in lattice units Δx=Δt=1. Examples cover D2Q9 isothermal low-Mach shear waves and Poiseuille flow. Formulations used by execution examples Supplementary execution exampleExample definition or validation formula Re100 lid-driven cavity: Ghia centerline comparison ωt+uωx+vωy=νΔω,−Δψ=ω,(u,v)=(ψy,−ψx) Re=UL/ν=100,ψ∣∂Ω=0,u(x,1)=1 (0<x<1) ωtop,i=−2ψJ−1,i/h2−2U/h,ωstationary=−2ψadj/h2+O(h) ω(1)=ωn+ΔtL(ωn),ωn+1=12ωn+12[ω(1)+ΔtL(ω(1))] March a real nonperiodic 2D viscous incompressible solver to steady state on 17/33/65 node grids and compare against original Ghia centerlines. Retain streamlines, grid vortex center, true PDE residual and discrete divergence. Supplementary execution exampleExample definition or validation formula LBM Re100 cavity: actual2D fields and Ghia centerlines fieq=wiρ[1+3ci⋅u+92(ci⋅u)2−32∣u∣2],νℓ=(τ−1/2)/3 fiˉ(x,t+1)=fi⋆(x,t)−6wiρ0ci⋅uw,ρ0=1 Re=UL/ν=100,t⋆=100 Advance genuine four-wall BGK flow on three fixed grids, checking nominal-lid Ghia centerlines, primary vortex, stationarity and wall momentum budgets. Exact and reference solutions Freeze21 pytest checks and94group gates. Linearly interpolate to17points per velocity transcribed after direct visual reading of original TablesI/II, printed398–399. Require finest component maximum errors≤.03, refinement decrease and steady residual≤1e−7. Also check primary-vortex grid location from TableV, wall values, Poisson residual and discrete divergence. Finite-grid numerical referenceReference for the same problem Ghia Re100: original finite-grid velocity centerlines u_ref(.5,y_j),v_ref(x_j,.5): original TablesI/II Re100; primary vortex(x,y)=(.6172,.7344): TableV. Unit square,Re100,unit top lid and stationary other walls. Transcribe17points each of u(.5,y) and v(x,.5) after direct inspection of original TablesI/II Re100 columns, preserving printed four-decimal coordinates. Separately compare the grid primary vortex(.6172,.7344) from TableV. These rounded finite-grid numerical tables are neither continuum exact values nor outputs from the present solver. Educational Re100 checks on three fixed grids. Lid/sidewall corner velocities are discontinuous; stationary corners take precedence. Ghia values are rounded numerical references, not an exact solution, and printed four-decimal coordinates are preserved. No high-Re, turbulence, original-algorithm reproduction or cavity-pressure validation is claimed. Finite-grid numerical referenceRelated-model reference LBM Re100 cavity: actual2D fields and Ghia centerlines Ghia1982Re100 centerline tables and primary-vortex location; these are rounded numerical data,not an exact whole-field solution. Physical unit square, lid1, viscosity.01, Re100; N24/32/48, lattice lid.04, dt=.04/N. Three stationary walls/rightward lid; stationary side owns a simultaneous top/side link. Initialrho1/rest. Physical unit square, lid1, viscosity.01, Re100; N24/32/48, lattice lid.04, dt=.04/N. Three stationary walls/rightward lid; stationary side owns a simultaneous top/side link. Initialrho1/rest. References and results of execution examples Supplementary execution example Re100 lid-driven cavity: Ghia centerline comparison Freeze 22 pytest checks and 94 group gates. Linearly interpolate to 17 points per velocity transcribed after direct visual reading of original TablesI/II, printed 398–399. Require finest component maximum errors≤.03, refinement decrease and steady residual≤1e−7. Also check primary-vortex grid location from TableV, wall values, Poisson residual and discrete divergence. Saved result / JSON Reference and validation details → Supplementary execution example LBM Re100 cavity: actual2D fields and Ghia centerlines 22pytest and37case gates. Fixed60k/80k/120ksteps reach t*=100with90/95/100saved. Finest u/v max error.03,vortex distance.06,late relativeL2 change2e-4andmass/wall-inclusive momentum gates are frozen. Saved result / JSON Reference and validation details → Numerical methods Advance vorticity transport with centered differences and Heun. Each stage solves−Delta_h psi=omega using a nonperiodic Dirichlet DST, then formsu=psi_y,v=−psi_x. Use local first-order Thom wall vorticity; this is an independent method, not Ghia CSI-MG or its higher-order wall formula. Methods used by this problem’s execution examples Centered spatial difference Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Heun / SSPRK(2,2) Method-registry status: Educational example / related code D2Q9–BGK collision and streaming Method-registry status: Educational example / related code Code and execution Supplementary execution example Re100 lid-driven cavity: Ghia centerline comparison March a real nonperiodic 2D viscous incompressible solver to steady state on 17/33/65 node grids and compare against original Ghia centerlines. Retain streamlines, grid vortex center, true PDE residual and discrete divergence. Conditions, commands and validation scope Assumptions Dimensionless unit square, viscosity .01, lid speed1, Re=100. Top interior nodes have u=1; other walls and all four corners have zero velocity. Psi=0 on every wall; initial interior vorticity 0. Reapply Thom wall vorticity at every Heun stage.
